scope: Bilibili PC websites and reviewed desktop HTTP GET probes only. No APK declarations are imported. A passed case covers its recorded input and field assertions, not every account role, page or future server version.

runs.scope: Single reviewed public input per read endpoint; signature/risk/login errors are preserved, no retry or anti-risk workaround. Only the listed business fields are asserted, not all edge cases or authenticated behavior.
Additional reviewed comment-reply, opaque next-page cursor and online-count checks. No account data or write operations.
Single controlled PC protocol comparison using web_location=1315875 from bili-comments.js. No login, cookies, risk retries or alternate credentials.

limitations: Static string literals are candidates, not confirmed callable APIs; bindings, URL composition and server contracts are not recovered by this scan.
Only listed desktop pages and public inputs were exercised. Login, writes, account roles, complete pagination and future versions are not covered.
Original frontend bodies, responses, browser state, signatures and cookies stay outside Git. Response hashes identify decoded CDP/fetch entity bodies, not compressed network packets.
